journal: Regime read transitional: SPY and QQQ negative across 1d/5d/20d with no timeframe agreement (SPY -0.72/-2.38/-3.39pct, QQQ -1.38/-4.60/-3.95pct), both below sma20/sma50 but above sma200 -- a pullback inside a longer uptrend, not a screen pass. XLE showed the pullback stalling (5d +0.13pct after -5.46pct 20d) so I took a small toehold (10 sh, 5.4pct weight) rather than a full-conviction add, and passed on SPY/QQQ this session. Did not use the Macro page's live snapshot for this read -- it always serves real-world current-date data regardless of which replay session is open, which would be lookahead if used to size a June 29 decision; sized off the no-lookahead brief watchlist only. Spent the rest of the session on the new Institutions tab and a walk of the other pages for regression, this run's stated focus.

SPY and QQQ both reaccelerated (+1.65pct and +2.49pct 1d) with QQQ closing right at its own sma20 after two sessions below it. 5d/20d still slightly negative so this is partial confirmation, not full risk-on -- added a second small position (QQQ, 2 sh, 14.7pct weight) rather than sizing up. XLE continues to lag (20d -4.8pct), held at the existing small toehold, no add. Spent most of the session on Institutions-tab edge cases: confirmed a defect (a real SEC NPORT-P futures/derivative row parses to issuer 'N/A' / identifier 'LEI:N/A' on both QQQ and IVV, badged 'New' like an equity buy despite a negative multi-million-dollar value -- the parser's LEI fallback doesn't exclude the literal string 'N/A' the way its CUSIP fallback does, and never tries the filing's own <title>/<ticker> fields which are populated for this exact row) and a second defect (RENTECH's Changes and Full Holdings tables keep showing the server's unfiltered New/Exit/Add/Trim counts and 'across N holdings' line even after 'only holdings I also own' reduces the visible table to zero rows -- confirmed with real DOM events after ruling out a harness click artifact). Sort correctness on RENTECH (3779 changes) and IVV (506 holdings, 21bn book) checked clean including negative Value Delta and near-zero/negative Weight ordering. A 503 from SEC on SCHD self-resolved on retry. Also hit one new, unrelated transient 500 on /api/thesis/holdout (sqlite 'database is locked' when the ledger and holdout requests raced on connection setup) -- recovered on the app's own retry.

XLE's own invalidation triggered: 5d momentum flipped back negative (-2.48pct vs +0.13pct at entry) and 20d worsened to -7.31pct, so exited the full 10-share position at 53.02 for a small realized loss rather than holding past its own thesis. QQQ's uptrend continues (1d +1.70pct, 5d +3.19pct, above sma20) and SPY confirms broad risk-on -- held QQQ unchanged. Continued Institutions-tab work: re-checked BRK and BRIDGEWATER (both load and sort correctly), and confirmed the honest-counts gap is not QQQ/RENTECH-specific -- IVV's Full Holdings provenance line ('across 506 holdings') also stays fixed after the owned-only filter empties the table. No SEC 503/429 reproduced again this session on retry.

Final session of this 4-session window (2026-07-03 has no stored SPY bar -- NYSE observes July 4th on the preceding Friday when the 4th falls on a Saturday, as it does in 2026 -- so the harness's own no-lookahead calendar correctly stopped at 07-02 rather than fabricating a fifth session; not a defect, noted per the harness README). QQQ dipped 1d (-1.53pct) but 5d momentum is still positive (+2.05pct) and the close (725.17) held above sma20 (722.68) -- the entry thesis is not invalidated, so held unchanged with no new orders. Week ends with 1 open position (QQQ), one realized loss (XLE, session 3), equity ,966.20 vs 0,000 starting (-0.34pct). Closed out Institutions-tab testing this session: unknown-key and out-of-window ?period= both return well-formed 404s naming the valid alternatives (confirmed via the API on 8011, not reachable through the UI's fixed dropdown); could not induce the documented 409 (InsufficientHistory) because every one of the 11 catalog funds has multiple years of quarterly filing history within the 6-filing candidate window the service fetches -- noting as untestable with the current catalog rather than guessing. Re-verified the honest-counts gap and the LEI:N/A derivative-row defect are still reproducible before writing them up.
